title: Pens
subtitle: Sign the boarding pass with something good.
description: Machined brass and aluminium pens with a NeverBeen monogram, smooth 0.5 mm refills and a satisfying weight.

NB-PN-001.name: Brass Ballpoint Pen
NB-PN-001.description: A machined brass ballpoint with a knurled grip and a click that feels expensive. It develops a patina as you use it.
highlights: Dispatched from India in 2 working days

NB-PN-002.name: Gel Pen Trio
NB-PN-002.description: Three quick-drying 0.5 mm gel pens in a slim sleeve, each with a matte wordmark near the clip.
highlights: Dispatched from India in 2 working days

NB-PN-003.name: Fountain Pen
NB-PN-003.description: A balanced aluminium fountain pen with an iridium medium nib, a converter and two ink cartridges in the box.
highlights: Dispatched from India in 2 working days
